title: Mushroom, carrot and butter bean barley pot

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or a plain cupboard staple such as tinned butter beans, pearl barley and stock, with no jars, packet mixes or substitutes.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded casserole, a knife and a grater, with simple frying and simmering.

works.reason: 200g barley in 1.2 litres of stock with 400g mushrooms, a tin of beans and spinach makes a loose but sound pot for four, and the timings for tender barley are right.

honest_times.reason: The page was asked to be quick, but the 35 to 40 minute barley simmer gives 20 prep plus 45 cook, over an hour, which is not a quick weeknight dinner.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the thyme, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: Browned mushrooms lead a gently warming barley pot that suits a cool mid-April evening.

plain_voice.reason: Short, clear steps in plain British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholegrain barley, beans, mushrooms, carrots and spinach make a filling, balanced family meal.
